ينتقعون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِعُونَ (yantaqiʕūna) /jan.ta.qi.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# يُنْتَقَعُونَ (yuntaqaʕūna) /jun.ta.qa.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
